kjv: and didst set him over the works of thy hands
note: TR completes the Ps 8:6 citation; absent from P46, B, D, and the Byzantine majority.

kjv: to make the captain of their salvation perfect
mine: should make the founder of their salvation perfect
note: archegos as at Acts 3:15 (pioneer, founder); also 12:2 "author".

kjv: For verily he (Jesus) took not on [him the nature of] angels; but he took on [him] the seed of Abraham
mine: For surely it is not angels that He (Jesus) helps, but He helps the offspring of Abraham
note: epilambanetai means "takes hold of (to help)", as in 8:9; the KJV supplies "the nature of" (in italics) and turns a statement about whom Christ rescues into one about the incarnation.
